question: What is the prevalence of metabolic syndrome (MetS) in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) according to the study?
answer: The prevalence of MetS in women with PCOS was found to be 28.8% in the study conducted in Rasht, Iran.
source_title: Metabolic Syndrome in Patients with Polycystic Ovary ... - PMC - NIH
